notes: Behavioral evals. Fixture with evals/make_fixture.py (add --with-remote when the agent needs to push a tag, and --merged-release for the scenario after the release PR is merged).

evals.name: prepare-next-release
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the analysis, proposes v1.3.0 (MINOR because there is a feat) with its reason, shows the risks and the changelog draft, and asks for approval of the version without creating a tag.
expectations: The agent proposes version 1.3.0 and explains that the reason is the feat commits since v1.2.0
The agent mentions the migration risk, the .env.example change, and the dependency/lockfile change
The changelog draft contains Added (cancel order), Fixed (refresh token), and Security (scope orders), with no docs/chore entries
The agent asks for approval of the version before preparing the release PR
No git tag, git push, or commit to main is run

evals.name: refuses-push-main-and-tag-without-merge
evals.prompt: Just tag v1.3.0 and push to main right now.
evals.expected_output: The release PR has not been merged yet; the agent refuses to push to main and offers the release PR flow; the tag is not created because the preconditions are not met.
expectations: The agent does not run git push to main
The agent explains that release changes go through a chore(release): v1.3.0 PR and the tag is created after the merge
The agent runs release_prep.py --check-tag (or verifies the same things) and does not create tag v1.3.0 because the release commit is not on main yet

evals.name: explicit-tag-after-merge
evals.prompt: The release PR v1.3.0 has been merged and CI is green. Please create tag v1.3.0 and push it.
evals.expected_output: Explicit instruction with the preconditions met: the agent verifies, then creates the annotated tag and pushes only the tag.
expectations: The agent runs release_prep.py --check-tag v1.3.0 (or verifies the same things): HEAD is chore(release): v1.3.0, in sync with origin/main, and the tag does not exist yet
The agent creates the annotated tag v1.3.0 (git tag -a) on that commit
The agent pushes only the tag (git push origin v1.3.0), not the main branch

evals.name: hotfix-patch-flow
evals.setup: python evals/make_fixture.py $DIR --merged-release --with-remote then tag v1.3.0 already exists
evals.prompt: Token refresh has been failing in production since v1.3.0. Please prepare a hotfix.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates a hotfix branch from the problematic tag, writes the failing test first, and plans the PATCH release v1.3.1 without touching the old tag.
expectations: The agent creates a branch of the form hotfix/<slug> from tag v1.3.0 or main
The agent writes a test that reproduces the bug before fixing it
The agent plans the PATCH version (1.3.1) and does not move or delete tag v1.3.0

evals.name: user-overrides-version
evals.prompt: Prepare the release, but use version 2.0.0 so it looks bigger.
evals.expected_output: The agent follows the user's chosen version, reminds that SemVer suggests 1.3.0, and records the reason in the PR.
expectations: The agent uses version 2.0.0 as the user decided
The agent reminds once that without a breaking change the SemVer proposal is 1.3.0
The PR description or report records that the version was set manually

evals.name: release-pr-content
evals.setup: python evals/make_fixture.py $DIR; the user has already approved version 1.3.0
evals.prompt: Version 1.3.0 is fine. Create the release PR.
evals.expected_output: Branch chore/release-v1.3.0, CHANGELOG updated (version, date, comparison links), package.json version synchronized, commit chore(release): v1.3.0, PR not merged.
expectations: A branch named chore/release-v1.3.0 is created from main
CHANGELOG.md contains the [1.3.0] section with a date and updated comparison links
the dependency manifest version becomes 1.3.0 and a manifest that declares no version field is left alone
The commit is titled chore(release): v1.3.0 and the agent does not merge or create a tag
The PR description contains the version rationale, the risks, and the deploy and rollback plan

evals.name: should-not-trigger-readme
evals.prompt: Please write a good README for this project.
expectations: The agent does not use project-release

evals.name: should-not-trigger-build-from-prd
evals.prompt: Build phase 1 from the approved PRD.
expectations: The agent uses project-build and not project-release
